AcquireTransactionLockAsync(DbContext, string, CancellationToken)

Acquires the exclusive lock named name, held until the current transaction ends. Backs AcquireTransactionLockAsync(string, CancellationToken); any context base can delegate here instead of repeating the lookup.

public static Task AcquireTransactionLockAsync(this DbContext context, string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

context DbContext

The context whose transaction the lock belongs to.

name string

Lock name. Identifies what is being serialized, e.g. "contract-number:53".

cancellationToken CancellationToken

A cancellation token to observe while waiting for the task to complete.

Returns

Task

Remarks

The statement is provider-specific, so it comes from the IDbContextTransactionLock registered by the provider package (AddDatabase). With none registered — an in-memory context built by hand in a test — there is no concurrency to serialize and the call does nothing.

Exceptions

InvalidOperationException

No transaction is active on context.
